notes:
Summary: Closed-lost during procurement after security review failure. InfoSec would not accept the artifacts provided; customer unwilling to share full SOC2/ISO evidence.

Timeline (high level):
- 2025-08-20: Initial inbound, product fit (support/chat + doc-search) — AE intro (Priya).
- 2025-09-03: Discovery call — mapped throughput/lattency needs (50 rps peak, 75ms target p95), strong residency requirement (NA).
- 2025-09-18: SE architecture workshop (Miguel) — recommended Private deployment (VPC + on-prem option) and Dedicated fallback.
- 2025-10-02: Sent security questionnaire + NDA; requested SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 evidence; also asked for pen-test summary and KMS details. (Drive: security questionnaire link).
- 2025-12-05: Security review call (30m) with Stonehaven InfoSec. They provided a "readiness" report and partial controls matrix but would not provide external attestation artifacts (no SOC2 report), citing vendor policy.
- 2026-01-10: Follow-up escalation to procurement/legal; asked for immediate bridging evidence (attestation letter, SOC2 auditor contact). Stonehaven declined to share auditor evidence.
- 2026-01-21: Stonehaven informs Redwood deal is paused; later that week they select a competitor offering explicit enterprise SOC2 evidence and a managed private instance.

Customer quotes / paraphrases:
- "We can't share the SOC2 report due to contractual constraints with our auditors." — InfoSec, 2025-12-05
- "We need a vendor that can demonstrate an external attestation today; our regulator won't accept internal readiness docs." — Procurement, 2026-01-10

Deal health notes / signals:
- Procurement + InfoSec were aligned on controls, but Stonehaven refused to provide attestations.
- No internal champion after procurement pushed back; product sponsor (CTO) stopped attending meetings in Dec.
- Budget not the primary blocker but procurement used the security gap to pause spend (effectively a freeze).

Technical requirements recap:
- Workloads: chat-based support agent + doc-search/re-ranking for customer support KB.
- SLOs: p95 latency <= 75ms for query-only flows; batch reranking throughput ~500 qps during nightly jobs.
- Data handling: PII redaction required; data residency in NA; KMS/HSM integration mandatory.

Why deal lost / root cause:
- Stonehaven refused to share third-party SOC2/ISO attestations; InfoSec would not accept readiness reports or partial evidence.
- Competitor provided public SOC2 report + references and offered dedicated managed instance within required residency.
- No internal champion to fight for exceptions; procurement defaulted to proven vendor.

Next actions for Redwood (internal):
- Mark account closed-lost; retain contact for future when attestations are available.
- Capture learnings: need clearer collateral about how Redwood handles attestations and vendor references (create one-pager for SOC2/ISO proof handling).
- Follow-up cadence: 6–9 months check for attestation availability.

Follow-up items and artifacts:
- Drive: stonehaven-security-response-2025.pdf (partial controls matrix).
- Jira: INF-7891 (SE deployment ask), SEC-3420 (security clarifications).
- Fireflies links for discovery + security call (IDs above).
status_summary: Closed-lost: security review failed / customer unwilling to share SOC2/ISO attestation. Lost to competitor with public attestations.
